concept.title: People in hardship or crisis
concept.shortdesc: Vulnerable people facing homelessness, poverty, displacement or urgent distress.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : People described generally as vulnerable or at risk, including those needing help to stay safe at home, with no single condition named.
: People who are homeless, sleeping rough or at risk of losing their home.
: People who have fled their country and are seeking or have been granted protection, including unaccompanied asylum-seeking children.
: Individuals and families struggling with money, on a low income or means-tested benefits, or otherwise in need of material help.
: People in urgent need, crisis or extreme distress who need immediate help, including children at serious risk of harm.
